consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if the ConsulCatalog provider `namespace` option is configured; the option must be replaced with `namespaces`.

original.statement: The ConsulCatalog provider `namespace` configuration option was removed in v3; its presence prevents Traefik from starting and must be replaced with the `namespaces` option.

decision.reason: [ev-3faa5287ea4e] says the ConsulCatalog `namespace` option is removed in v3, is "now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", and that `namespaces` should be used instead. If the operator keeps the old option configured, the upgraded Traefik cannot start. That fits upgrade-blocked (an unmet precondition stops the upgrade from completing), which means mandatory work. Critical severity is justified because the proxy does not come up at all.
